values: All stages retained; only Full campaign / Screening enters the primary comparison.
File bytes include debug symbols unless stripped. Own libraries exclude system-library distribution files.
Single instrumented pipeline run per variant; current RSS/PSS are distinct from primary GNU peak RSS.
Per-function and build reports; these are not total stack bounds, and LTO can emit multiple versions.
Sources are the supplied Pi archive and its extracted records. No Mac trials enter this workbook.
/Users/matthewketas/Desktop/University of Pittsburgh/Senior Year/7th Semester/Embedded Systems/Memory Homework
Full campaign, Screening; 28 valid variants × 4 units × 3 repetitions = 336 trials. Combined candidate has 12 additional screening trials.
156 records retained in Runs; it has different work counts and one repetition, so it is not pooled into the main charts.
Median of three run peaks. Lower/higher labels require nonoverlapping observed min–max ranges against the matched -O2 unit. This is descriptive, not a significance test.
RSS counts all resident shared pages. PSS divides shared pages proportionally. Snapshots describe instrumented diagnostic runs, not repeated screening trials.
For example, diagnostic -O2 reports GNU peak 1,088 KiB while its finished-work smaps RSS is 1,712 KiB. Preserve both; the cause is unresolved.
Only explicit memory-unit allocation requests are instrumented. Allocator metadata, libraries, stack and static data are excluded. Static storage moves rather than erases storage demand.

Text section measures code. Executable file includes debug information unless stripped. Own-library bytes exclude installed system libraries; inspect dependencies before inferring total deployment size.
The compiler reports individual frames, sometimes after inlining. These are not a whole-call-stack bound. Static-library builds may report frames for unlinked functions.
Applied after process startup. Existing mapped stack can exceed a later limit; the lowest passing cap does not prove that many bytes suffice from startup. Data caps also cover non-heap data.
Five of nine invalid-input checks failed. The runner retained the build and excluded all four screening workloads. Missing measurements stay unavailable.

Immutable 22.5 C CSV fixture supplies a base value; a deterministic ramp and outliers are added. Accelerated replay uses synthetic timestamps. No physical sensor or intensive future predictor is represented.
50- and 25-sample versions use their own O0 references. Passing those checks does not preserve the original history length or prediction evidence.
Two paced 600-sample pipeline trials per selected configuration, about 60 s each. They are shown separately because workload count differs from screening.
Amber cells are intentionally blank. They capture your observations, proposed explanations, and decisions before drafting the paper.

Sample rows were independently counted; full synthetic temperature outputs remain in the supplied archive. All 597 measurement records, builds, phase snapshots and stack-frame records are included here.
Independent checks compare each result JSON with raw GNU time, program stdout, and counted output rows.
